name: United Blood Nation
description: The United Blood Nation (UBN), also known as the East Coast Bloods, is a prison-originated gang confederation founded on July 16, 1993 at Rikers Island by Omar 'OG Mack' Portee and Leonard 'OG Dead Eye' McKenzie to protect African American inmates from the Latin Kings and Ñetas. It operates as the East Coast branch of the California-based Bloods, concentrated along the Eastern Seaboard, with criminal activities including drug trafficking, robbery, extortion, and prostitution. Major subgroups include Nine Trey Gangsters and Sex Money Murder.
